name: tokentally
description: Token usage in, dollar totals out.

scripts.format: oxfmt --write src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts vitest.config.ts README.md
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts vitest.config.ts README.md
scripts.lint:oxlint:typeaware: pnpm exec -- oxlint --deny-warnings --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.json --config .oxlintrc.json src tests
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm format && pnpm exec -- oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --fix src tests
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:oxlint:typeaware && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build
